description.text: McIntire-Stennis Act District of Columbia Equality Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

bill.title: McIntire-Stennis Act District of Columbia Equality Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill adds the District of Columbia to the McIntire‑Stennis Cooperative Forestry Act's list of entities eligible for federal forestry research funds. It makes D.C. eligible alongside states, land‑grant institutions, and territories for McIntire‑Stennis formula and competitive grants supporting forestry research and education.

impact.summary: The bill would amend the McIntire‑Stennis Cooperative Forestry Act to add the District of Columbia to the list of jurisdictions eligible for McIntire‑Stennis research grant funds. It would let District government and District forestry or university research programs apply for grants administered by USDA NIFA.
